sentences.review: 'The way is long' is unidiomatic English; suggest 'It's a long way.' (this also applies to the same example in adjective.lang_vs_lange).
'How long is the way?' is unnatural English; suggest 'How long is the route?' or 'How far is it?' (this also applies to the same example in adjective.lang_vs_lange).

meanings.gloss: for (a period of time), after a time expression

sentences.text: Wir waren eine Woche lang in Rom.
sentences.en: We were in Rome for a week.

sentences.text: Tony war zwei Jahre lang in Wien.
sentences.en: Tony was in Vienna for two years.

sentences.text: Ich war ein Jahr lang in Australien.
sentences.en: I was in Australia for a year.

sentences.text: Er hat den ganzen Tag lang nichts gesagt.
sentences.en: He didn't say anything all day long.

sentences.text: Drei Jahre lang hatte Leanna keine Arbeit.
sentences.en: Leanna had no work for three years.
